scope: Independent metadata-only final-source search v3: CSA planetary LIBS and Aalto LASOLIBS
summary: CSA access restored with official HTTPS endpoint and TLS verification; exact numeric filenames confirmed through range-fetched ZIP directory. KD2 is promising jointly low Fe/Mg reference material, not a qualified blank. Aalto URLs/license resolved but axis/purity/group metadata missing. No new final source admitted.

extraction.method: raw DEFLATE; archive CRC32 002c33a6 verified; no spectral member downloaded

csa_archive_file_inventory.json.note: Only ZIP central directory names, sizes, CRC and stored timestamps; timestamps are not claimed as acquisition sessions.

policy.negative: Published nonzero point estimate 0 < oxide wt% <= 0.1; positive >= 1; zeros and missing entries unknown. These labels remain conditional on established units/basis. Point estimates do not qualify a certified bound or procedural blank.

license.title: Open Government Licence - Canada
license.note: Dataset metadata isopen=false despite explicit Open Government Licence - Canada; use license field, not assumption from public access.

csa.access_resolution: Use donnees-data.asc-csa.gc.ca HTTPS with normal certificate verification; ftp.asc-csa.gc.ca legacy endpoint timed out.

instrument.name: Ocean Optics LIBS2000
instrument.reason: Acquisition atmosphere does not prove reported wavelength medium; CSA guide, associated Koujelev2011 chapter and inspected instrument documentation do not explicitly establish air/vacuum scale.

acquisition_grouping.1000average: 1000 shots at 10 spots averaged into one spectrum per certified material
acquisition_grouping.200average: 200 shots at 2 spots averaged into one spectrum per material
acquisition_grouping.statistical_unit: physical material; shot counts are not independent records; shared material across average products remains same group
acquisition_grouping.count_discrepancy: Archive/assay contains different totals from guide; no silent drop or forced equality.

csa.assay_basis_caution: XLS CertifiedSamplesSubset explicitly Fe2O3; MaterialLargeSet/CSV FeO header duplicates certified Fe2O3 entries, including JA1=.0707. Both interpretations for low hand Fe entries remain below0.1wt% but exact FeOT basis is unresolved without original Actlabs report. Other-material KD2 is explicitly elemental Fe/Mg.

graphite_kd2.composition_source: Other materials subset worksheet row 2 / csa_compositions_subset.csv row 2
graphite_kd2.units_evidence: Official Brammer geological catalogue p27 explicitly states mg/kg for CIBA KD-2: Fe 180, Mg (21), matching CSA fractions 0.00018 and 0.000021. Multiplying the mass fractions by 100 gives elemental wt%.

catalogue_status.Mg: Parenthesized catalogue value (21), not accepted here as certified; exact KD2 certificate and its legend are absent.
catalogue_status.supplier_caution: Brammer introduction instructs use paperwork rather than catalogue; no lot certificate retrieved.

graphite_kd2.spectral_to_composition_mapping: Only graphite entry in Other materials subset and only Graphite TXT in certified folder; natural inference, not explicit lot-ID filename. LargeSet has no graphite row or Graphite TXT.

independence.note: Do not equate with unspecified ChemCam graphite pellet/holder. CIBA KD2 identity is new by available aliases; no same-lot acquisition evidence.

graphite_kd2.blank_type: synthetic reference material with measured impurities; no documented procedural/method blank preparation or certified upper bound

search_limitations: No sample-specific CIBA KD2 certificate/uncertainty retrieved; official certificate index does not list KD2.
Generic mineral names and vendor provenance are insufficient for full lot-level cross-campaign identity proof.
No explicit CSA wavelength medium found; no axis inferred from spectral peaks or test output.

axis_document_review.finding: Third-order pixel-to-wavelength calibration and Hg/Ar reference lines; neither air nor vacuum explicitly specified. 2026 instructions do not establish CSA 2010 calibration convention.
Calibration method and known-line wavelength table; no explicit air/vacuum declaration. Related HR2000+ instrument manual is not a CSA instrument-specific calibration certificate.
Calibration sheet is unit-specific and includes coefficients and reference lines. CSA unit-specific sheet is absent from inspected archive metadata.
HR2000 manual not linked; related HR2000+ manual linked and retrieved. No dataset-specific axis provenance obtained.

license.evidence: Pure-element dataset entry in datasets page; site footer CC-BY-SA must not override dataset-specific CC0.

aalto.numerical_data: Individual processed spectra available via element plot CSV exports; full raw multiple-measurement download remainsTODO. No new plot or intensity downloaded in this search. Cu had already been inspected in an earlier task, so Cu cannot serve as untouched final.
aalto.processing: Continuum-removed99%-quantile across multiple measurements; spectra may originate from pure elements or references with known constituents; filtered multielement and theoretical series coexist.
aalto.axis_blocker: Calibration uses theoretical peaks and ambientO/N lines; no explicit air/vacuum axis statement. Ambient atmosphere is not axis metadata.
aalto.chemical_truth_blocker: No specimen-specific purity, Fe/Mg impurity bounds, CoA, lot IDs or independently assayed low-Fe values found on current pages. Labels pureelement do not proveFe/Mgabsence.
aalto.acquisition_groups: Bulk averaging and signal-quality selection prevent reconstruction of independent sample/replicate groups from plotted spectrum.
